The Tamil Nadu government has given G. Laxmi Priya, Secretary-II to Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, full additional charge of the post of Special Officer, Mudhalvarin Mugavari.
She will replace P. Amudha, Additional Chief Secretary, Cooperation, Food and Consumer Protection, who was holding the additional charge. Chief Secretary M. Sai Kumar issued an order to this effect.
